This '''national electoral calendar for 2019''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2019 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==February==
*3 February: [[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2019 Salvadoran presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://elmundo.sv/tse-define-fecha-para-eleccion-presidencial-2019/|title=TSE define fecha para elección presidencial 2019|date=October 16, 2017|work=Diario El Mundo|access-date=December 8, 2019|archive-date=December 8, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191208002504/https://elmundo.sv/tse-define-fecha-para-eleccion-presidencial-2019/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*10 February: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2019 Swiss referendums|Referendum]]
*23 February: [[Elections in Nigeria|Nigeria]], [[2019 Nigerian general election|President, House of Representatives and Senate]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Nigeria election 2019: Voting postponed for a week |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47263122 |date=16 February 2018 |work=[[BBC News]] |access-date=17 February 2019}}</ref>
*24 February: 
**[[Elections in Cuba|Cuba]], [[2019 Cuban constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2019 Moldovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Vițu |first1=Valeria |title=24 februarie 2019, ziua alegerilor parlamentare în R.Moldova |url=https://www.rfi.ro/politica-105011-24-februarie-2019-ziua-alegerilor-parlamentare-rmoldova |work=[[RFI România]] |date=27 July 2018 |access-date=7 August 2020 |language=Romanian}}</ref> and [[2019 Moldovan referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://jamestown.org/program/state-of-play-ahead-of-moldovas-parliamentary-elections|title=State of Play Ahead of Moldova's Parliamentary Elections|publisher=[[Jamestown Foundation]]|date=14 December 2018}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Senegal|Senegal]], [[2019 Senegalese presidential election|President]]
*25 February: ''[[Elections in the British Virgin Islands|British Virgin Islands]], [[2019 British Virgin Islands general election|Legislature]]''

==March==
*3 March: [[Elections in Estonia|Estonia]], [[2019 Estonian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*5 March: [[Politics of the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2019 Micronesian parliamentary election|Parliament and Referendum]]
*10 March: 
**[[Elections in Guinea-Bissau|Guinea-Bissau]], [[2019 Guinea-Bissau legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dw.com/en/will-elections-in-guinea-bissau-end-years-of-political-crisis/a-47830379|title=Will elections in Guinea-Bissau end years of political crisis?|date=10 March 2019|work=[[Deutsche Welle]]}}</ref>
**[[Elections in North Korea|North Korea]], [[2019 North Korean parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*16 March: [[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2019 Slovak presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="Slovakia">{{cite news |title=Anti-corruption candidate Zuzana Caputova leads Slovak poll |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47599946 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=17 March 2019 |access-date=17 March 2019}}</ref>
*24 March: 
**[[Elections in Comoros|Comoros]], [[2019 Comorian presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], {{ill|2019 Ecuadorian CPCCS election|lt=Council for Citizen Participation and Social Control|es|Elecciones del Consejo de Participación Ciudadana y Control Social de Ecuador de 2019}}
**[[Elections in Thailand|Thailand]], [[2019 Thai general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/politics/1616422/general-election-on-march-24 |title=General election on March 24 |work=[[Bangkok Post]] |date=23 January 2019 |access-date=7 August 2020 }}</ref>
*30 March: 
**[[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2019 Slovak presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="Slovakia"/>
**''[[Elections in the United States Virgin Islands|U.S. Virgin Islands]], [[2019 United States Virgin Islands electoral system referendum|Referendum]]''
*31 March: [[Elections in Ukraine|Ukraine]], [[2019 Ukrainian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="UkrainePres">{{cite news |title=Ukraine election: Comedian leads presidential contest |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47767440 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=1 April 2019 |access-date=1 April 2019}}</ref>

==April==
*3 April: [[Elections in the Solomon Islands|Solomon Islands]], [[2019 Solomon Islands general election|Parliament]]
*6 April: [[Elections in the Maldives|Maldives]], [[2019 Maldivian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*7 April: [[Elections in Andorra|Andorra]], [[2019 Andorran parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*9 April: [[Elections in Israel|Israel]], [[April 2019 Israeli legislative election|Parliament]]
*11 April: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (1st phase)]]
*14 April: [[Elections in Finland|Finland]], [[2019 Finnish parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*17 April: [[Elections in Indonesia|Indonesia]], [[2019 Indonesian general election|President, House of Representatives and Senate]]
*18 April: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (2nd phase)]]
*20–22 April: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2019 Egyptian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |last1=Yeranian |first1=Edward |title=Mixed Emotions as Egyptian Constitutional Referendum Begins |url=https://www.voanews.com/a/mixed-emotions-as-egyptian-constitutional-referendum-begins/4884368.html |work=[[Voice of America]] |date=20 April 2019 |access-date=20 April 2019}}</ref>
*21 April: 
**[[Elections in North Macedonia|North Macedonia]], [[2019 North Macedonian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="NMKD">{{cite news |last1=Crosby |first1=Alan |last2=Spasovska |first2=Mirjana |title=It's All Academics When It Comes To North Macedonian Vote |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/all-academics-when-it-comes-to-north-macedonian-vote/29893477.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=20 April 2019 |access-date=20 April 2019}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Ukraine|Ukraine]], [[2019 Ukrainian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="UkrainePres"/>
*23 April: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (3rd phase)]]
*28 April: 
**[[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2019 Beninese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Spain|Spain]], [[April 2019 Spanish general election|Congress of Deputies]]
*29 April: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (4th phase)]]

==May==
*5 May: 
**[[Elections in North Macedonia|North Macedonia]], [[2019 North Macedonian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="NMKD"/>
**[[Elections in Panama|Panama]], [[2019 Panamanian general election|President and Parliament]]
*6 May: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (5th phase)]]
*8 May: 
**[[Elections in Belize|Belize]], [[2019 Belizean territorial dispute referendum|Referendum]]
**[[Elections in South Africa|South Africa]], [[2019 South African general election|National Assembly]]
*12 May: 
**[[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (6th phase)]]
**[[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2019 Lithuanian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="Lithuania">{{cite news |title=Lithuania election: PM Saulius Skvernelis to quit after poor result |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48249482 |date=13 May 2019 |work=[[BBC News]] |access-date=13 May 2019}}</ref> and [[2019 Lithuanian constitutional referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bnn-news.com/week-in-lithuania-lithuania-to-hold-referendum-on-reducing-number-of-mps-197171|title=Week in Lithuania. Lithuania to hold referendum on reducing number of MPs|work=Baltic News Network|date=17 February 2019}}</ref>
**''[[Elections in New Caledonia|New Caledonia]], [[2019 New Caledonian legislative election|Legislature]]''
*13 May: [[Elections in the Philippines|Philippines]], [[2019 Philippine House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2019 Philippine Senate election|Senate]]
*18 May: [[Elections in Australia|Australia]], [[2019 Australian federal election|House of Representatives and Senate]]
*19 May: 
**[[Elections in India|India]], [[2019 Indian general election|House of the People (7th phase)]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2019 Swiss referendums|Referendums]]
*21 May: [[Elections in Malawi|Malawi]], [[2019 Malawian general election|<s>President</s> and Parliament]] (presidential election nullified)
*24 May: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[Thirty-eighth Amendment of the Constitution Bill 2016|Constitutional Referendum]]
*26 May: 
**[[Elections in Belgium|Belgium]], [[2019 Belgian federal election|Federal Chamber of Representatives]]
**[[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2019 Lithuanian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="Lithuania"/>
**[[Elections in Romania|Romania]], [[2019 Romanian referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Romania Voting On Controversial Fraud And Judicial Reforms |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/29963404.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190526050016/https://www.rferl.org/a/29963404.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=May 26, 2019 |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=26 May 2019 |access-date=26 May 2019}}</ref>
*27 May: [[Elections in Madagascar|Madagascar]], [[2019 Malagasy parliamentary election|National Assembly]]

==June==
*2 June: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[2019 Sammarinese referendum|Referendums]]
*5 June: [[Elections in Denmark|Denmark]], [[2019 Danish general election|Parliament]]
*9 June: 
**[[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2019 Kazakh presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Kazakhstan To Hold Snap Presidential Election On June 9 |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kazakhstan-president-snap-election-toqaev-nazarbaev/29869956.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=9 April 2019 |access-date=10 April 2019}}</ref>
**''[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2019 South Ossetian parliamentary election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Georgia's Breakaway South Ossetia Region Holds 'Elections' For Parliament |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-s-breakaway-south-ossetia-region-holds-elections-for-parliament/29990541.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=10 June 2019 |access-date=10 June 2019}}</ref>
*16 June: [[Elections in Guatemala|Guatemala]], [[2019 Guatemalan general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]
*22 June: [[Elections in Mauritania|Mauritania]], [[2019 Mauritanian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.africanews.com/2019/04/18/mauritania-to-hold-presidential-election-on-june-22/|title=Mauritania to hold presidential election on June 22|via=Africanews|work=[[Agence France-Presse]]|date=18 April 2019|access-date=18 April 2019}}</ref>

==July==

*21 July: 
**[[Elections in Japan|Japan]], [[2019 Japanese House of Councillors election|House of Councillors]]
**[[Elections in Ukraine|Ukraine]], [[2019 Ukrainian parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==September==
*8 September: ''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2019 Abkhazian presidential election|<s>President (2nd round)</s>]]'' (election nullified)
*9 September: [[Elections and political parties in Tuvalu|Tuvalu]], [[2019 Tuvaluan general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/392250/tuvalu-to-go-to-the-polls-on-9-september|title=Tuvalu to go to the polls on 9 September|date=17 June 2019|work=[[Radio New Zealand]]|access-date=19 June 2019}}</ref>
*15 September: [[Elections in Tunisia|Tunisia]], [[2019 Tunisian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.tap.info.tn/fr/Portail-Politique/11674656-l-%C3%A9lection|title=L'élection présidentielle anticipée aura lieu le 15 septembre prochain (Porte-parole de l'ISIE)|work=[[Tunis Afrique Presse]]|date=25 July 2019|access-date=25 July 2019}}</ref>
*17 September: [[Elections in Israel|Israel]], [[September 2019 Israeli legislative election|Parliament]]
*28 September: [[Elections in Afghanistan|Afghanistan]], [[2019 Afghan presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Ghani Rules Out Forming Another Unity Government, Rejects Threat Of Civil War |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/ghani-elections-interview/30185139.html |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=26 September 2019 |access-date=26 September 2019}}</ref>
*29 September: [[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2019 Austrian legislative election|National Council]]

==October==
*5 October: [[Elections in United Arab Emirates|United Arab Emirates]], [[2019 Emirati parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news|title=FNC candidate registration centres launched |url=https://gulfnews.com/uae/fnc-candidate-registration-centres-launched-1.65682332|work=[[Gulf News]]|date=7 August 2019|access-date=15 August 2019}}</ref>
*6 October: 
**''[[Elections in Kosovo|Kosovo]], [[2019 Kosovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Kosovo Leader Resigns After Being Called to War Crimes Court |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/19/world/europe/kosovo-leader-resigns-after-being-called-to-war-crimes-court.html|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=19 July 2019 |access-date=20 July 2019}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2019 Portuguese legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Tunisia|Tunisia]], [[2019 Tunisian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*13 October: 
**[[Elections in Poland|Poland]], [[2019 Polish parliamentary election|Sejm and Senate]]
**[[Elections in Tunisia|Tunisia]], [[2019 Tunisian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.france24.com/en/20190927-exclusive-tunisia-presidential-election-run-off-vote-set-october-13-kais-saied-nabil-karoui|title=Exclusive: Tunisia presidential run-off vote set for October 13|date=September 27, 2019|work=[[France 24]]}}</ref>

*17 October: ''[[Elections in Gibraltar|Gibraltar]], [[2019 Gibraltar general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.yahoo.com/gibraltar-hold-general-election-eve-brexit-161429793.html|title=Gibraltar to hold general election on eve of Brexit|work=[[Yahoo! News]]|date=16 September 2019|access-date=7 August 2020}}</ref>
*20 October: 
**[[Elections in Bolivia|Bolivia]], [[2019 Bolivian general election|<s>President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate</s>]] (election nullified)
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], {{ill|2019 Swiss federal election{{!}}National Council and Council of States (1st round)|de|Schweizer Parlamentswahlen 2019/Resultate Nationalratswahlen|de|Resultate der Ständeratswahlen (2019–2023)}}
*21 October: [[Elections in Canada|Canada]], [[2019 Canadian federal election|House of Commons]]
*23 October: [[Elections in Botswana|Botswana]], [[2019 Botswana general election|Parliament]]
*27 October: 
**[[Elections in Argentina|Argentina]], [[2019 Argentine general election|President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
**[[Elections and parties in Oman|Oman]], [[2019 Omani general election|Consultative Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/elections_om/status/1175659715998691329?s=19|title=#الأحد 27 أكتوبر موعد التصويت #لانتخابات_أعضاء_مجلس_الشورى_للفترة_التاسعة #يوم_التصويتpic.twitter.com/xhpTT06is9|first=انتخابات أعضاء مجلس|last=الشورى|date=September 21, 2019}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Uruguay|Uruguay]], [[2019 Uruguayan general election|President (1st round), Chamber of Deputies, Senate]] and [[2019 Uruguayan constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref name="Uruguay">{{cite news |title=Uruguay presidential election to go to second round |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50207881 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=28 October 2019 |access-date=28 October 2019}}</ref>

*3 November: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], {{ill|2019 Swiss federal election{{!}}Council of States (2nd round 1st phase)|de|Resultate der Ständeratswahlen (2019–2023)}}
*5 November: [[Politics of the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2019 Micronesian Constitutional Convention election|Constitutional Convention]]

==Indirect elections==
The following [[indirect election]]s of [[head of state|heads of state]] and the [[upper house]]s of bicameral legislatures took place through votes in elected [[lower house]]s, [[Unicameralism|unicameral legislatures]], or [[electoral college]]s:
